classification.difficultyReason: Draw and label triangles satisfying stated side and angle properties.

content.prompt: Draw the triangles given by these descriptions,

answer.worked: Draw an isosceles triangle with apex $Z$ and base $YX$. Label the vertices and put matching double arcs at $X$ and $Y$ to show the equal base angles.

answer.short: All three sides have different lengths and no angle is $90^{\circ}$. One possible drawing is shown.
answer.worked: Draw a triangle with three different side lengths and no right angle. Label its vertices $P$, $Q$ and $R$.

spec.description: Scalene triangle PQR with horizontal base PR, Q above the base toward R, vertex dots and exterior labels.

answer.short: $\angle RPQ=90^{\circ}$, with three different side lengths. One possible drawing is shown.
answer.worked: Draw perpendicular sides $PQ$ and $PR$ of different lengths, then join $Q$ to $R$. Label the vertices and mark the right angle at $P$. The three side lengths are different, so the triangle is scalene.
